# Avani Palm View Dubai

> Avani Palm View Dubai Hotel & Suites is a 48-storey hotel and serviced-apartment tower in Al Sufouh 2, beside Dubai Media City and facing the entrance to Palm Jumeirah. It offers 264 rooms, suites and apartments in eleven layouts, from 440-square-foot studios to four-bedroom homes of about 1,750 square feet. Facilities include a dual-level infinity pool, a gymnasium, restaurants and a cafe, with the Dubai Tram and Palm Monorail close by.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Al Sufouh, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2021

## MENASCO Scope

The Al Sufouh Mixed-Use Development is a high-rise tower on a TECOM plot in Al Sufouh, Dubai, with two basements, a ground floor, four podium levels and 43 upper floors beneath the roof. It was developed for Al Fahim with AECOM Middle East as consultant. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the tower.
